rationale: Lactate oxidation coupled to sulfate reduction, the canonical metabolism of D. piger. Lactate (8 mmol/gDW/h) is oxidized incompletely to acetate and CO2, with sulfate as terminal acceptor producing H2S. Ammonium uptake (2.5 mmol/gDW/h) meets nitrogen demand for growth at 0.25 /h. Carbon and nitrogen balance verified. Conservative rates chosen after turn 3 failure.
